evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Ask for confirmation before archiving a record. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Register the confirmation renderer at the dialog host. Treat its result as a decision; only the requesting caller owns the effect and its outcome.
assertions: Choose the exact affirmative result. Done: Yes is the only result that starts the archive request; dismissal has the same effect as No.
Await the effect and keep busy scoped to that operation. Done: a rejected response produces failure feedback and releases the trigger in finally.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: Cancelling a confirmation still archives the item. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: An unresolved confirmation usually means the trigger is outside the registered dialog host. Do not attach another mutation to a rendered Yes button.
assertions: An unresolved confirmation usually means the trigger is outside the registered dialog host. Do not attach another mutation to a rendered Yes button.
Await the effect and keep busy scoped to that operation. Done: a rejected response produces failure feedback and releases the trigger in finally.
Count requests across cancel, failed confirmation and successful confirmation. Done: cancel sends none, each Yes sends one, and feedback distinguishes failure from success.
